checks.name: Full contract test suite (vitest, npm test)
checks.detail: mise exec -- npm test → 2 test files, 15 tests, all passed (262ms). tests/contracts/calculator.test.ts: 9 tests (add:1, sub:1, mul:1, div:2, mod:2, pow:2 — pow post ResultIsPower for (2,3)/(-2,3)/(5,0), and explicit no-precondition assertions for b<=0 and a=0 cases). tests/contracts/memory.test.ts: 6 tests, unaffected. No regressions in pre-existing operations.

checks.name: Live HTTP smoke test against POST /calculate and /memory/* (manual, supplementing absent automated integration suite)
checks.detail: Started `npm start` on PORT=3919 and curl'd end-to-end: POST /calculate {op:pow,a:2,b:10} -> 200 {result:1024}; {op:pow,a:2,b:-1} -> 200 {result:0.5} (negative exponent NOT rejected, confirming no precondition); {op:pow,a:0,b:0} -> 200 {result:1} (edge case NOT rejected). Regression spot-check: add/sub/mul/div/mod all return correct results via HTTP; div/mod by zero still return HTTP 400 {error:'divisor must be non-zero'} (PreconditionError path unaffected by pow addition); memory/add, /memory/recall, /memory/subtract, /memory/clear all behave correctly. Note: this repo has no automated HTTP/integration-level test file (tests/ only contains tests/contracts/calculator.test.ts and memory.test.ts, both unit-level against the Calculator/Memory modules directly) — this gap is pre-existing and applies equally to add/sub/mul/div/mod, not introduced by this item and not part of npm test. This check was performed manually (live curl against a running server), not by an automated harness, to satisfy the 'checkable via HTTP/API' framing in requirements/calculator.feature's Feature description; it is not repeatable via npm test and should not be read as closing that pre-existing gap.
